kind: Unchanged frozen learner fields for root review; no new review approval claimed
title: Build Workforce foundations and record unapproved time
summary: Connect a fictional employer, establishment, existing member, one-day employment and assignment; save and reopen two Regular hours with approval left off.
prerequisites: An authorized Core account with access to the demonstrated Workforce forms.
A fictional practice department; this example uses existing fictional member Matthew Casey and an existing training personnel role.
Review existing records first. Do not overwrite an employer profile, duplicate an existing worker, overlap dated records or reuse another work-entry reference.
Only browser configuration and stored readbacks are demonstrated. No attendance, payroll, legal-coverage, compensation, resource-cost or cost-run outcome is established.

practice.title: Start with the Workforce overview
practice.practice: Identify the employer, worker and employment counts before making any practice changes.

practice.title: Enter a clearly identified practice employer
practice.practice: In a clean training profile, choose a fictional name. In an existing profile, review without replacing stored details.

practice.title: Save without declaring coverage
practice.practice: Locate the lower employer Save, then compare the saved and fresh name readbacks without resaving.

practice.title: Add an establishment with a recognizable code
practice.practice: Read back the code and state before saving; use a new unique code only in a separately authorized practice setup.

practice.title: Check the establishment dates and saved row
practice.practice: Compare the catalog’s full training name with the reopened code, date and time zone; do not resave merely to inspect.

practice.title: Link the existing member as a worker
practice.practice: Distinguish the existing-member path from the external-worker fields. Reuse an existing training worker for read-only review rather than adding it again.

practice.title: Create a deliberately short employment period
practice.practice: Read the worker name and both dates. Do not add an overlapping period to the already-created example.

practice.title: Choose the period defaults and save the correct form
practice.practice: Locate the employment-panel Save rather than the separate worker Save. Verify the stored period and defaults.

practice.title: Give the job assignment its own dates and location
practice.practice: Compare the initial CA field with the prepared IL value. Check assignment dates separately from employment dates.

practice.title: Save the assignment without inventing classifications
practice.practice: Confirm the saved title and establishment, then inspect the fresh IL/date readback without changing classification fields.

practice.title: Use the correct work-entry date window
practice.practice: Confirm the displayed window includes the practice day before looking for the entry. No filter-change success is demonstrated here.

practice.title: Prepare two Regular hours with the intended location
practice.practice: Read worker, date, hours type and location back together. Distinguish the initial CA default from the prepared IL value.

practice.title: Keep the entry unapproved and identify its source
practice.practice: Identify the unchecked Approved control and separate empty payroll-cost field. Do not infer a full external value from the clipped input.

practice.title: Verify the saved entry and fresh readback
practice.practice: Compare the saved row with both parts of the fresh edit form. Finish without resaving or approving the example.

practice.title: Review the foundation and apply the pattern
practice.practice: Explain which records were saved and which approvals or costing activities were not performed.

sector_examples.title: Fire and EMS
sector_examples.scenario: Practice linking a training member to a dated training-base assignment and an unapproved work entry; do not treat it as verified station attendance.

sector_examples.title: Community response and mental-health teams
sector_examples.scenario: Use the same location, worker and dated-assignment review for community-care coordination; keep sensitive client details outside this software exercise.

sector_examples.title: Search and rescue
sector_examples.scenario: Practice a one-day volunteer coordination period and confirm the saved dates before reviewing an unapproved entry.

sector_examples.title: Security
sector_examples.scenario: Use a clearly marked training site and worker record to rehearse date/location checks without claiming a completed patrol.

sector_examples.title: Wildland
sector_examples.scenario: Use contractor-team practice context to check worker, assignment bounds and work location; this lesson creates no labor-contractor entity or legal classification.

sector_examples.title: Industrial response
sector_examples.scenario: Use a fictional operating establishment and dated coordination assignment; saving the entry supplies no payroll approval or physical-response verification.
